From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec signal digest: competitor pricing & model releases — QBR prep

Team —

As we lock down QBR slides, there are a few near-term market moves worth calling out that should inform our narrative and ask planning. High level first, then recommended next steps.

Top signals (last 72h):
- OrionAI (public): launched a new 7B to 70B family with a new consumption tier priced ~18% below our mid-tier for high-throughput text gen. They emphasize cost-per-token and a 99% uptime SLA for their hosted service.
- HorizonCloud: closing a pilot with a mid-market fintech; we have visibility into a procurement note: they are pushing for a cross-region discount + 6 month pilot pricing.
- Two small open-source distros posted quantized checkpoints this week that could drive lower-cost self-hosted alternatives in the market.

Implications for our QBR story and OKRs:
1) Positioning: lean into reliability and predictable unit economics — emphasize Dedicated/Private options and predictable SLA-backed throughput.
2) Pricing: recommend we add a slide highlighting cost controls (batching, KV caching, quantization guidance) and an optional limited-time field credit for pilots where procurement requests aggressive short-term discounts.
3) Competitive risk: OrionAI's low-price messaging is likely aimed at high-volume customers; push CS to map accounts by token intensity and prioritize renewals for high-risk deals.

Immediate asks (this week):
- Laura: update the QBR appendix with a simple competitive price table (see attached snapshot) + one slide that calls out our differentiation versus low-price entrants.
- Karthik: prepare a 2-slide executive note on tradeoffs (quality vs cost) with a recommended pilot credit structure and the OKR impact for Revenue/ACV.
- Vivek & Marissa: validate whether any active renewals this quarter are on the list of high token usage accounts and flag top 10.

Attachments: competitor_pricing_snapshot_Q4_2026.xlsx, qbr-appendix-competitive-slides_v1.pptx

I'll consolidate for the QBR draft on Thursday. Quick reactions welcome — one-line replies are fine.

— Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
